reason: The Milestone 7 specification says not to use final-test labels to construct operational warnings. In one-hour-ahead autoregressive forecasting the previous hour's count is both an outcome and a legitimate model input, so every policy (and both models) necessarily uses earlier test-period counts. The enforceable requirement is causality: a day-d decision uses only data observed before day d, and no threshold, scale or rule is fitted on test-period data. The perf policy and TRIAD rule R4 additionally use the model's realised past errors (delayed-label monitoring).
